articles.title: Lanterns Scores Series High 10 Million Viewers Globally With Controversial Third Episode
articles.summary: The series "Lanterns" faces controversy despite positive critical reception, primarily due to the decision to kill off the popular character Hal Jordan, portrayed by Kyle Chandler, in its final moments. This narrative choice has divided audiences and sparked significant debate regarding its impact on the storyline and character legacy, prompting discussions within fan communities.

articles.title: PM Modi urges auto industry innovation for Viksit Bharat; pushes for EV acceleration
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi urged India's automobile industry to innovate and pursue excellence, seeing its critical role in achieving the 'Viksit Bharat' vision by 2047. He emphasized how indigenous technological advancement and industrial growth are vital for national progress and economic strength, aligning with the broader goal of a developed and self-reliant India.
